title: As a customer, I want to filter products by category so that I can find items more quickly
description:
As a customer
I want to filter products by category
So that I can find items more quickly without scrolling through all products

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given I am on the product listing page, when I select a category filter, then only products in that category are displayed
acceptanceCriteria.given: I am on the product listing page
acceptanceCriteria.then: only products in that category are displayed
